text.title: Felâk Sûresi
text.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
text.expectedArabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
text.latin: Kul eûzü bi-Rabbil-felak. Min şerri mâ halak. Ve min şerri ğâsikın izâ vekab. Ve min şerrin-neffâsâti fil-ukad. Ve min şerri hâsidin izâ hased.
text.expectedLatin: Kul eûzü bi-Rabbil-felak. Min şerri mâ halak. Ve min şerri ğâsikın izâ vekab. Ve min şerrin-neffâsâti fil-ukad. Ve min şerri hâsidin izâ hased.

limitations: Isolated headless Linux Chromium at 320×740, 393×873 and 1280×900. This does not establish physical Samsung/Android touch, audible recitation or screen-lock behavior.

Open, close, disclosure, source/content/select, Escape and wheel scrolling use trusted Playwright browser input. Setup, programmatic tefekkür exit, tab selection, event bursts, access grant/revocation and simulated legacy group reconstruction use explicitly labelled production APIs or DOM simulation.

The active-audio case stores a labelled generated 30-second PCM tone only in disposable personal-recording storage and starts the actual smart-session controller. Native HTMLMediaElement play/pause/currentTime/ended are observed, never replaced.
Byte-for-byte local production sources are served with service workers blocked; there is no live user profile, microphone or private recording.
